rule: Text on screen in at most 70% of body frames. Aim for about 55%.
evidence: CORE talking 0.53 (n=7) vs low-base outliers 0.92 (n=22), p=0.008. 10k+ median 0.79 (n=24) vs under 10k 0.93 (n=25), p=0.004. Under 70%: 6/7 vs 2/22. Reels DeP6zuMh75z, DeIIxY1htfk, Dd6k5N5qhg8, DeUzupxqKea.

rule: At most 2 words of overlay text per frame, median over the body.
At most 3 designed animations in 0 to 5 s. Target 2.
measure: count of judged.animations with t < 5 and type != none

rule: Do not force an animation in the first second. Let the proof move instead of decoration.
threshold: not required (flag decoration-only motion in 0 to 1 s)
evidence: Animation by 1.0 s: 10k+ 12/24 vs under 10k 20/25, p=0.033. CORE 3/7.

rule: Body hard cuts at least 2 per 10 s.
Median shot length 3.0 s or less.
evidence: CORE 2.67 s (n=7). 10k+ 3.05 s (n=24) vs under 10k 6.03 s (n=25), p=0.077. Matches RULES.md 16 (3.0 s).
10k+ 3.34 s (n=24) vs under 10k 7.37 s (n=23), p=0.031. Hard cut in 0 to 3 s 10/24 vs 4/25, p=0.064. CORE alone 5.47 s (n=7) vs 4.69 s (n=20): groups disagree.

rule: Speaker face on screen in at most 70% of the body. Cut away to the proof.
Open on the proof: greenscreen over the post, split with proof on top, or proof first.
evidence: CORE 6/7 vs low base 14/22, p=0.39. Greenscreen 3/7 vs 3/22. Reels DeP6zuMh75z, DeIIxY1htfk, Dd6k5N5qhg8, DdysDw5t4Km, DeB6QU6N4Ec, Dd4YlP-JEhh.

rule: First spoken line is a news drop: named product plus 'just launched / just got / just killed'.
measure: first sentence of transcript, news pattern (see scripts/4_outlierlab_transcripts.py) or judged.verbal_hook == news_drop
evidence: Creator share of news first lines vs median views: Spearman 0.64, p < 0.001, n=36 creators, 1,962 transcripts. CORE 14% vs low base 4%. Hook lab 10k+ 9/24 vs 4/25, p=0.12. No link to Breakout rate (rho -0.07).

rule: Spoken pace at least 4.0 words per second. Cut pauses and dead air.
evidence: CORE 4.28 (n=430) vs others 3.51 (n=1,532). CORE outliers 4.52 (n=119) vs CORE typical 4.15 (n=257). Hook lab CORE 4.13 (n=7) vs 3.59 (n=22), p=0.45. Creator rho vs median 0.18, p=0.30.

rule: Speech, face and text all start at 0.0 s.
evidence: Median 0.0 s in every group. Speech by 0.5 s in 87% of 55 viral reels. Norm, not a differentiator.

rule: 10 to 14 spoken words in 0 to 3 s.
evidence: All 55 viral reels median 10 (IQR 8.5 to 14). CORE talking 13 (n=7). No group gap.

rule: Burned-in captions are optional. If used: word by word, no keyword colour.
evidence: CORE no captions 6/10 vs low base 5/24, p=0.048. Keyword colour 0/10 CORE, 8/55 overall. Conflicts with RULES.md 18 (grey pill).

rule: No more than 1 SFX per 10 s. None required in 0 to 5 s.
evidence: CORE median 0 per 10 s (n=10). SFX in 0 to 5 s 2/7 vs 7/22, p=1.0. Detector catches about 1 in 4 SFX.

rule: Music is optional. If used: in from 0.0 s, 12 to 16 dB under the voice.
threshold: start <= 0.2 s; 12 to 16 dB under voice
evidence: Bed in 2/7 CORE; 9/24 vs 9/25 by baseline, p=1.0. Start median 0.0 s (n=24). 14 dB under voice (n=18 talking reels with music).

rule: Mix at -14 LUFS, plus or minus 0.5.
Length 30 to 55 s. Do not cut short just to be short.
evidence: CORE all reels median 43.4 s (IQR 31 to 55, n=436). Within creators, outliers 2.4 s longer than typical (19 of 33). Creator rho length vs median -0.14, p=0.44.

rule: End on 'follow me and comment [WORD]'. Keep as a default; do not expect lift.
measure: judged.body.ending_cta_type; 'follow' and 'comment' in last 40 transcript words
evidence: Comment-keyword ending in 37/55 viral reels and 8/10 CORE. Within creators no lift (median change 0, n=33). Follow ask in 53% of CORE reels vs 8% to 22% elsewhere (mavgpt 77%, kayvon.ai 63%, opusjake 54%). Creator rho follow vs median 0.09.
